contract:
Contract ListBookHistory::listRecommendBook(uid: String): Set(RecommendBook) {
	definition:
		recommendationRecords: Set(RecommendBook) = RecommendBook.allInstances()
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->exists(u: User|u.UserID = uid) and
		recommendationRecords.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		result = recommendationRecords->select(rb: RecommendBook|if rb.RecommendUser.oclIsUndefined() = false 
		then rb.RecommendUser.UserID = uid 
		else false 
		endif )
}
